solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Nonsense to applaud with role backfiring

parts.note: to applaud is to clap

indicators.note: something backfiring goes the wrong way, so this word is read from end to start

parts.note: an actor's role is their part

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses as rubbish the idea of cheering a performance that went wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Showy empty talk meant only to win applause is a standard synonym for rubbish or nonsense.

clue.text: Just nothing left in New York

parts.note: O, the figure zero, stands for nothing

indicators.note: the letters for nothing and left go inside the abbreviation for the city

explanation.surface: A remark that there is barely anything remaining in the Big Apple.
explanation.definitionFit: As adverbs both mean merely or solely, as in 'just a minute'.

clue.text: Boss takes leader of industrialists round workroom

parts.note: a stud is a raised ornamental boss, as on a shield or belt

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here from industrialists

parts.note: O is round in shape, so it stands for round

explanation.surface: A manager brings the head of a group of industrialists on a tour of the work premises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boss' looks like a manager but is the decorative knob, STUD.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or photographer's room for working in is a synonym for a workroom.

definitions.meaning: a harsh critic who runs things down
the hinged striker on a front door used by visitors

explanation.definitionFit: A habitual fault-finder is so called, and the metal striker on a front door bears the same name.

definitions.meaning: a very thin fracture, as in a fine crack in china or bone
the line along which hair is parted on the scalp

explanation.definitionFit: A very thin fracture is so called, and the edge of hair growth or a hair parting is the same word.

definitions.meaning: whimsically, a box in which people chatter on the telephone

explanation.definitionFit: A person who talks endlessly is a gossip, and a phone booth is jokingly a box for talking in.

indicators.note: a roused mob is stirred up, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A movie in which a crowd claims to have been stirred into action.
explanation.definitionFit: A low-budget supporting feature is a kind of film, so the two are synonyms in the specific sense.

clue.text: Things drifting, not turned round by board

parts.note: a plank is a long flat board of wood

indicators.note: turned round means the word not is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Floating debris refuses to be swung about by a piece of timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Things drifting' sounds vague but is a fair description of creatures carried by currents rather than swimming.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny organisms that drift in the sea rather than swim are things drifting, the literal meaning of the Greek root.

definitions.meaning: present in one's own house, as in 'is anyone in?'
a party where guests are received at one's house

explanation.definitionFit: Being in means being at one's house, and an informal party for guests in one's house is the same term.

clue.text: Agile Romeo embraced by Mata Hari?

indicators.note: the letter for Romeo is held inside the word for the famous agent

parts.note: Mata Hari was a notorious First World War spy, an example signalled by the question mark
R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A nimble lover is caught in the arms of the legendary seductress.
explanation.definitionFit: Lively and nimble, especially of an older person, is a synonym for agile.

indicators.note: ground means crushed and broken up, so these letters are reworked into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone imagines a former spouse out at a sports ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornamental rather than plain is the adjectival sense of fancy, a synonym.

indicators.note: tamed means broken in, so these letters are worked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A man called Ron breaks in a sturdy horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tamed' rearranges COB and RON; 'cob' is a sturdy horse in the surface but only fodder here.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild or half-tamed horse of western North America is an example of a horse.

indicators.note: bothering means disturbing, so these letters are stirred into a new order
tailless means the final letter of the spider's name is cut off

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A big hairy spider without its rear end is pestering a plant scientist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tailless' drops the last A from TARANTULA; 'bothering' rearranges TARANTUL plus IS.
explanation.definitionFit: A student of natural history, such as one who studies plants, includes a botanist as an example.

parts.note: read not as plain but as looking in a wicked way, casting a malicious glance

explanation.surface: An exclamation that someone is unattractive.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a malevolent gaze that supposedly brings harm means looking at people in a bad way.

parts.note: late here means dead, so the words describe an inscription on a grave about someone who has died

explanation.surface: A question about remarks on breaking news.
explanation.definitionFit: A short text written in memory of someone dead, as on a tombstone, comments on the departed.

parts.note: a situation is a job or post
a vacant seat is free

explanation.surface: A job advertisement notes that applications can be posted without paying.
explanation.definitionFit: Mail sent without needing postage prepaid by the sender is a common term for no stamp required.

clue.text: Plants in this place may conceal trap

indicators.note: the place word could hide the trap word within it

parts.note: here means in this place
to bag is to catch or trap

explanation.surface: Greenery round here might hide a snare.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass and leafy vegetation collectively, as grazing, is a term for plants.

parts.note: GA is the abbreviation for the US state of Georgia, plus S for the possessive
light means not heavy, so easily carried

explanation.surface: A carryable lamp belonging to Georgia.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamp burning coal gas, as in Victorian streets, is an example of a lamp.

parts.note: Peter Pan is J. M. Barrie's boy who never grew up
an ache is a pain

explanation.surface: Someone's showy style irritates a man named Peter.
explanation.definitionFit: Stylish verve and confident dash is a synonym for flair.

clue.text: Cleaner's mother welcoming one's special appeal

indicators.note: the cleaner's mother takes the shortened one's into the middle, as if receiving a guest

parts.note: a char is a British cleaning lady, and the possessive links her to the mother
MA is an informal word for mother
one is I, and 's is read as is

explanation.surface: A domestic help's mum greets a visitor with great allure.
explanation.walkthrough: A CHAR is a British cleaning lady; read 'Cleaner's mother' as a char's ma, two pieces that close round 'one's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Compelling attractiveness or magnetism that inspires devotion is a special appeal.

indicators.note: in a down clue, overlooks means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
eight is a number

explanation.surface: A hospital ignores a figure for the top of a mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overlooks' seems to mean ignores but places H above EIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest point of something, as in the height of fame, matches summit.

clue.text: Discrimination shown by second divorcee one's married

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse
one is I, and 's is read as is

explanation.surface: Prejudice is evident when a man's second ex-wife remarries.
explanation.definitionFit: Prejudice on grounds of gender is a specific kind of discrimination.

parts.note: to witness is to see
a saw is a woodcutter's tool

explanation.surface: An observer watches a lumberjack's arm going up and down.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-and-fro or rising and falling movement is a figurative sense of the playground plank.

clue.text: List of items turns Liberal off

indicators.note: turns means changes, so the letters of these words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A political party member is put off by a programme.
explanation.definitionFit: A menu is a list of the dishes available, so items of food.

indicators.note: to remove signals that a letter is taken away from the bird's name
the tail of a word is its last letter, which is what goes

parts.note: a snipe is a wading bird; the 's links to its tail

explanation.surface: An instruction to trim a bird's tail feathers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to remove' and 'tail' drop the last E of SNIPE.
explanation.definitionFit: A small cut made with scissors is a synonym for a cut.

parts.note: the main is an old poetic word for the sea

explanation.surface: Shutting down the principal railway route.
explanation.definitionFit: To seal an envelope or deal is to close it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Being virtuous, he acts out of character

indicators.note: the phrase hints the letters are shaken out of their normal arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Being good, a man behaves unlike his usual self.
explanation.definitionFit: Pure and abstaining from improper sexual conduct is a sense of virtuous.

clue.text: Teacher's account seen by the man as source of worry

parts.note: the head teacher, called simply the head
he is a pronoun for the man

explanation.surface: A head teacher's financial record, looked at by a man, causes anxiety.
explanation.definitionFit: A pain in the head, figuratively a troublesome problem, is a source of worry.
